newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish air cargo traffic rose six pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Spanish air cargo traffic rose six pct in August.

text.p: Air cargo traffic at the 39 airports run by Spain's airport authority AENA rose 6.1 percent in August to 33,740 tonnes, AENA said.
The total for the eight month period was 9.1 percent higher at 316,050 tonnes.
National cargo business was flat in the month while international freight volume rose nearly 12 percent to 18,508 tonnes.
Madrid's Barajas airport handled 16,731 tonnes in August, up 2.5 percent on the same month last year, taking its total so far this year to 155,311 tonnes, an increase of 4.0 percent.
Vitoria showed the strongest growth among the top five cargo airports with 95 percent more traffic, followed by Palma de Mallorca which saw a rise of nearly 27 percent.
